== Summary ==
Full-card remaster of [[Wise Advice (V) (Virtual Set: Defensive Shields)|Wise Advice (V)]] (slip 07 of [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields]]): the Players Committee's slip set onto the printed Decipher card, re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's Holotable cards. Fan reconstruction made with the SWCCG card maker (billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), 2026; not a Committee product.

Sources: slip from [https://web.archive.org/web/20071028141121/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/DefensiveShields.pdf DefensiveShields.pdf] (Players Committee sheet, Internet Archive 28 October 2007), official text as of 4 December 2006; top half, lore and art from the printed Decipher card.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-4/43/PS1-07-Wise_Advice-remaster.webp Internet Archive item].
